Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: 16:9 landscape pixel-art game background for The Witches' Road, fixed 640x360 scene.
Primary request: a magical overgrown Victorian greenhouse for Rio Vidal's earth-and-death trial, an original game location inspired by Agatha All Along's tangible woodland roots and botanical Green Witch imagery. Weathered black iron ribs arch overhead, dusk-blue glass roof, twisted roots, ferns, moss, small red flowers, rich dark soil, hanging plants, moonlit violet woodland beyond. Atmospheric and inviting, the quiet beauty of growing things.
Composition: fixed wide front three-quarter interior view. Keep the lower-left and middle floor clear, a broad flat mossy stone bed from x=55 to420,y=180 to325 in a 640x360 view, where code will draw exactly five stones and seven vines. Do not draw those stones or puzzle vines. On the right leave open space for a separate Rio sprite at x=520,y=330. A low wooden potting bench behind, glass bottles and a single red flower pot; no big foreground plants obscuring the floor. Full bleed landscape 16:9.
Style: richly crafted crisp 16-bit pixel-art adventure background, square pixel clusters and restrained dithering, indigo and evergreen shadows, emerald/teal moonlight, small warm amber lanterns, matching the detailed warm cabin and divination tower already in the game.
Constraints: no people, no lettering, no UI, no labels, no logos or watermark, no embedded graph, no painted puzzle answers. Complete scene rather than a collage.

Constraints: truly transparent background with alpha, no colored background or painted checkerboard, no cast shadow outside figure, no text, no logo, no watermark, no UI, no other characters. Coherent hands and anatomy. The red flower is the only held prop.
